fields.title: Python & Data Foundations for Data Science
fields.description: This module introduces learners to Python programming and essential data handling concepts required for data science. Students will learn how to work with datasets, perform data manipulation, and visualize data using industry-standard Python libraries.
fields.learning_objectives:
Understand Python basics for data science

Work with data using NumPy and Pandas

Perform data cleaning and preprocessing

Create basic data visualizations using Matplotlib and Seaborn

Gain hands-on experience with real-world datasets
fields.prerequisites:
Basic computer knowledge

Familiarity with high school–level mathematics (algebra)

No prior programming experience required

fields.title: Statistics, Probability & Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
fields.description: This module focuses on the statistical foundations required for data science. Learners will explore data using descriptive statistics, probability concepts, and visualization techniques to uncover patterns and insights.
fields.learning_objectives:
Understand descriptive and inferential statistics

Apply probability concepts in real-world datasets

Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data

Visualize data for better decision-making
fields.prerequisites:
Completion of Module 1

Basic understanding of Python and Pandas

High school–level mathematics

fields.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
fields.description: This module introduces core machine learning concepts, algorithms, and workflows. Learners will build predictive models using supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
fields.learning_objectives:
Understand machine learning concepts and types

Build supervised learning models (Regression & Classification)

Apply unsupervised learning techniques

Evaluate and tune machine learning models

Work with real-world ML datasets
fields.prerequisites:
Completion of Modules 1 & 2

Understanding of statistics and EDA

Comfortable with Python programming

fields.title: Artificial Intelligence & Advanced Machine Learning
fields.description: This module dives deeper into AI concepts and advanced ML techniques. Learners will explore neural networks, deep learning fundamentals, and real-world AI applications.
fields.learning_objectives:
Understand core Artificial Intelligence concepts

Build neural networks using popular frameworks

Apply deep learning techniques

Work with unstructured data (text & images)

Explore real-world AI use cases
fields.prerequisites:
Completion of Modules 1, 2 & 3

Strong understanding of machine learning basics

Familiarity with linear algebra fundamentals

fields.title: Model Deployment, Capstone Project & Industry Practices
fields.description: This final module focuses on deploying machine learning models and applying data science skills in real-world scenarios through a capstone project.
fields.learning_objectives:
Deploy ML models into production

Work with APIs and cloud platforms

Understand MLOps fundamentals

Build an end-to-end data science project

Present insights and models professionally
fields.prerequisites:
Completion of all previous modules

Knowledge of ML and AI concepts

Willingness to work on real-world projects
